facts.text: Villa Maria College provides free textbooks and course supplies for all students, schedules no Friday classes, and issues monthly Lyft transit credits and dining funds.

sources.title: Villa Maria College | Event Details
sources.quote: Perks of being a Viking: Textbooks and supplies are free for all students. Eat for free in our brand new Commons – all students get $75/semester in Viking Bucks. Viking Ride – all students get a monthly Lyft credit to get to & from campus for free. Free NFTA bus passes for all students. Parking is always free and there are lots close to all buildings. No Friday classes.
